title: Rory and the Moonlit Hollow
verses:
As the shadows grew long on the moss-covered ground,
And the silver moon rose over valley and hill,
Little Psittaco chirped at a magical sound,
As the forest grew sleepy and peaceful and still.

As Tilly walked slow by the shimmering stream,
Big Benny stepped heavy and safe on the ground.
The glow-worms shone bright like a beautiful dream,
Where the coziest shelter was soon to be found.

High up in the sky, gentle Nia swooped low,
While Rory stepped softly with smiling green grace.
She guided them all with a starlight-ed glow,
Right into the heart of the quietest place.

Stout Ricky laid down on a bed of soft ferns,
And rested his chin on his heavy front paw.
Above them the wheel of the night sky now turns,
To guard them in peace that the world ever saw.

Little Psittaco nested deep down in the leaves,
As gentle winds whispered a lullaby song.
Safe under the roof that the willow tree weaves,
Where all of the sleepy friends truly belong.

As Rory closed eyes while the night-shadows fell,
With Benny and Tilly so cozy and near,
The moon whispered soft as it cast a sweet spell,
"Goodnight to the dinos we love and hold dear."
